## 显著性——差异比较

```{r}
library(ggplot2)
pal <- c("#0072B2", "#D55E00","#122cad")

theme_nature <- theme_classic(base_size = 6.5, base_family = "sans") +
  theme(
    axis.line        = element_line(linewidth = 0.35, colour = "black"),
    axis.ticks       = element_line(linewidth = 0.35, colour = "black"),
    axis.title       = element_text(size = 6.5),
    axis.text        = element_text(size = 6.0),
    legend.title     = element_blank(),
    legend.text      = element_text(size = 6.0),
    legend.position  = "top",
    legend.direction = "horizontal",
    legend.justification = "center",
    legend.margin    = margin(0, 0, 2, 0, "pt"),
    legend.key.size  = unit(2.4, "mm"),
    panel.grid       = element_blank()
  )



df <- ToothGrowth

df
str(df)

df$dose <- as.character(df$dose)
p <- ggplot(data = df,mapping = aes(dose,len,fill = supp)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "summary", fun = "mean",position = position_dodge(1))+
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0, 40))+
  scale_fill_manual(values = pal) +
  theme_nature
p
    layer_data(plot = p ,i = 1) |> DT:::datatable()
```

<https://r-graphics.org/RECIPE-ANNOTATE-SEGMENT.html>

```{r}
p + annotate("segment", x = 0.75, xend = 1.25, y = 20, yend = 20,
           arrow = arrow(ends = "both", angle = 90, length = unit(.2,"cm")))+
    annotate("segment", x = 1.75, xend = 2.75, y = 35, yend = 35,
           arrow = arrow(ends = "both", angle = 90, length = unit(.2,"cm")))
```

```{r}
p +
  # 括号1：剂量 0.5 组，OJ(0.75) ↔ VC(1.25)，y = 20
  annotate("segment", x = 0.75, xend = 1.25, y = 20, yend = 20, linewidth = 0.35) +
  annotate("segment", x = 0.75, xend = 0.75, y = 19.2, yend = 20, linewidth = 0.35) +
  annotate("segment", x = 1.25, xend = 1.25, y = 19.2, yend = 20, linewidth = 0.35) +
  # 括号2：x = 1.75 ↔ 2.75，y = 35
  annotate("segment", x = 1.75, xend = 2.75, y = 35, yend = 35, linewidth = 0.35) +
  annotate("segment", x = 1.75, xend = 1.75, y = 34.2, yend = 35, linewidth = 0.35) +
  annotate("segment", x = 2.75, xend = 2.75, y = 34.2, yend = 35, linewidth = 0.35)
```

```{r}
# 括号数据框：每条括号 3 段 = 1 条横线 + 2 条向下竖线
brackets <- data.frame(
  x    = c(0.75, 0.75, 1.25, 1.75, 1.75, 2.75),   # 每段起点 x
  xend = c(1.25, 0.75, 1.25, 2.75, 1.75, 2.75),   # 每段终点 x
  y    = c(20,   20,   20,   35,   35,   35),      # 每段起点 y
  yend = c(20,   19.2, 19.2, 35,   34.2, 34.2)     # 每段终点 y（竖线向下）
)

p + geom_segment(data = brackets,
                 aes(x = x, y = y, xend = xend, yend = yend),
                 linewidth = 0.35, inherit.aes = FALSE)
```

```{r}
library(rstatix); library(ggpubr)

stat.test <- df %>%
  group_by(dose) %>%
  t_test(len ~ supp) %>%        # 每组内的 OJ vs VC
  add_significance()

stat.test <- add_xy_position(stat.test, x = "dose", dodge = 1)
# 自动得到（与手动 layer_data 结果完全一致）：
#   dose  xmin  xmax  y.position  p.signif
#   0.5   0.75  1.25  24.2        **
#   1     1.75  2.25  30.0        **
#   2     2.75  3.25  36.6        ns

p + stat_pvalue_manual(stat.test, label = "p", tip.length = 0.015)
stat.test2 <- df |> 
  filter(supp == "OJ")  |> 
  t_test(len ~ dose) |> 
  add_significance() |> 
  add_xy_position(x = "dose", dodge = 1)

p + stat_pvalue_manual(stat.test2, label = "p.adj", tip.length = 0.015)
```
